thread:
jas: Quick follow-up from the sampling discussion: I dropped a compact mock that shows a selector (First / Random / Stratified / Highest delta) plus a tiny legend explainer. Can UX/Eng weigh in on defaults and keyboard behavior?
ralph: backend can do approximate quartiles for Stratified; cost is small if we sample only 4 buckets. Default sounds fine.
olivia: prefer 'Stratified' as default but label it in UI as 'Representative (stratified)' so non-ML folks get it. Tooltip should say: 'Picks examples across score ranges.'
kevin: keyboard: make selector a native select for simplicity or a role="listbox" widget with arrow nav. Native select gives consistent focus behavior across platforms.
mira: tiny a11y nit: legend needs explicit labels not color-only. Add text 'Pass / Marginal / Fail' and put sr-only descriptions.
a11y-bot: Reminder: if samples update on change, announce with aria-live="polite": 'Samples updated: 4 previews'. Also ensure tooltip reachable by keyboard (aria-describedby).
qa-bot: Added tests: sample-selector-default, stratified-approx-quartile, selector-keyboard. Scheduling next run.
jas: Awesome, thanks. I'll update the mock to show "Representative (stratified)" as default, switch the selector to native for now, and add the legend text. Will post updated frames in 30m. :sparkles:
